answer: Gate throughput with a refundable bond priced per identity cluster: agents stacked on one funding terrace or sharing correlated timing are folded into a single cluster whose bond grows quadratically with its size. An honest agent posts a tiny bond; an attacker flooding an ocean of a thousand sybils owes roughly a thousand times more. Rewards drip like nectar only after bonded, peer-attested work settles, so unbonded forgeries earn nothing and any equivocation slashes the stake.
